readout_other: FDG-PET standardized uptake value and asymmetry index; H&E histology
direction_notes: Sonication raised FDG uptake (asymmetry index 7.9 percent vs -0.8 percent in controls) at the center of the focus only, interpreted as increased local glucose metabolism.
safety_notes: Behavior monitored every two days and H&E histology in two animals at 36 days showed no tissue damage or hemorrhage.

exposures.label: 350 kHz pulsed FUS near unilateral thalamus for 40 min

device.model: air-backed spherical segment single-element transducer, 6 cm diameter, 7 cm radius of curvature

timing.protocol_description: Tone bursts of 0.5 ms at 1 kHz PRF for 300 ms sonications repeated at 2 s intervals for 40 min starting immediately after FDG injection; PET acquired afterwards for 60 min.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Two groups $( n = 7$ for each) of animals were subjected to the subsequent PET imaging.
